title: Information Requested By The Japanese Consular Police Re Frank Geiringer, Austrian

page_data.en:
202-C
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 6911
Section 2, Special Branch,
REPORT
Date. Sept. 20, 19 35.
Subject. Information requested by the Japanese Consular Police re Frank
Geiringr, Austrian.
Made by D.S. Lingard Forwarded by D.S.I. [签名]
As the result of enquiries it has been ascertained
that Frank Geiringr is a man of very good character.
Geiringr has had considerable experience in hotel management
in Europe apart from what he has had in China, and he is
considered by those who know him to be a very competent and
keen individual. His local references include Messrs Milling-
tons, and the Manager of the Hongkong Shanghai Hotels, Shanghai,
and it is quite evident that the individual concerned is trying
to make an honest living in the hotel business.
Copy of this report forwarded
to Japanese Consular Police
1G
[签名]
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)
File
报

202-C
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 6911
特务科第二股，
报告
日期：1935年9月20日。
事由：日本领事馆警察询及奥地利人弗兰克·盖林格（Frank Geiringr）之资料。
撰写人：D.S. Lingard 转呈人：D.S.I. [签名]
经查询查明，弗兰克·盖林格品行甚佳。
除在中国的经历外，盖林格在欧洲拥有丰富的酒店管理经验，据了解他的人认为，他是一位非常能干且敏锐的人士。其在本地提供的推荐人包括美灵顿公司（Messrs Millingtons）以及上海香港饭店（Hongkong Shanghai Hotels, Shanghai）的经理，显然该人士正试图在酒店业中谋得正当生计。
本报告副本已转送
日本领事馆警察
1G
[签名]
D. S.
副总监（特务科）
存档
报

page_data.en:
N.K.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S. 2. Special Branch Subdiv.
REPORT
Date. September 5, 1935
Subject... Information requested by the Japanese Consular Police re Frank
Geiringr, Austrian.
Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by L S J Byrne

No record in
S.R. Reg. Gen

The local Japanese Consular Police request that they
be furnished with information concerning the character of an
Austrian named Frank Geiringr, age 26, residing at the Para-
mount Hotel, 218 Yu Yuen Road. This individual came to Shang-
hai in 1933. The information is wanted by the Consular
Authorities because Geiringr recently applied for the issue of
a pass authorising him to travel free by train in Japan where
he intends to make a tour of inspection and study Japanese
hotel accommodation and conditions.

D. Kamashita
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号
S. 2. 特务科分股
报告
日期：1935年9月5日
事由：日本领事馆警察询及奥地利人弗兰克·盖林格（Frank Geiringr）之资料。
撰写人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：L S J Byrne

特别巡捕房总登记册
无记录

当地日本领事馆警察请求提供有关一名名为弗兰克·盖林格（Frank Geiringr）的奥地利人的品行资料，该人26岁，居住于愚园路218号百乐门酒店（Paramount Hotel）。此人于1933年来到上海。领事当局需要此信息，是因为盖林格最近申请签发一种通行证，授权其在日本免费乘坐火车旅行，他打算借此巡视并考察日本的酒店住宿及状况。

D. Kamashita
D. S.
特务科副总监
